What to expect

From first call to fixed

From first call to a working appliance, with no surprises along the way.

  1. 1

    Call, text or book online

    It takes about a minute. Tell us the appliance, the brand and what it's doing. We reply quickly from 8am to 6pm.

  2. 2

    Confirmed within the hour

    Within an hour, often sooner, you get a same-day or next-day appointment (visits start at 9am) and the name of your technician.

  3. 3

    A 2-hour arrival window

    No waiting at home all day. You get a 2-hour window, plus a text about 30 minutes before arrival when your technician is on the way.

  4. 4

    $80 diagnosis, free with repair

    The technician finds the cause and gives you the full price before any work starts. Approve the repair and the service call is free.

  5. 5

    Fixed, usually in one visit

    Factory (OEM) parts from authorized distributors. 1 year on parts, 90 days on labor.
